newsitem.title: USA: Wrong "Mr Sullivan" is really Mr Wright.
newsitem.headline: Wrong "Mr Sullivan" is really Mr Wright.

text.p: Students at Morningside High School knew their "Mr. Sullivan" as a strict English teacher who would kick them out of class for talking.
Now the Los Angeles County District Attorney's office has kicked "Mr. Sullivan" out of class after 10 years, it was announced Wednesday.

"Mr. Sullivan" was Willie Clifton Wright, who has been charged with numerous felonies for stealing the identity of a teacher at another Los Angeles area school. The imposter was uncovered when the real Robert Sullivan retired last year from the Los Angeles Unified School District.

As a result, Wright was arrested and arraigned this week on five counts of perjury, two counts of impersonating Sullivan and one count of grand theft for collecting a salary from the suburban Inglewood School District as a teacher.
He is free on bail of $25,000 and is due in court Aug. 14, the District Attorney's office said. If convicted of all counts, Wright faces at least eight years in prison.
Prosecutors allege Wright, 59, assumed Sullivan's identity about 10 years ago after somehow obtaining the teacher's credentials.
